builds.name: Nino but she breaks abyssal
builds.desc:
This set has personally carried me through abyssal content. Fury is a very overrated skill and is very bad for desperation units imo, since it is basically only adding +3 atk and spd once in desperation range. It is easier than you might think to get units into desperation range without fury, and it usually takes only one combat to do so. Swift sparrow also doesn't maximize potential as brazen atk/spd provides a better gain(brazen atk/spd 3 even has 1 point of attack over SS3, or brazen atk/spd 4 has +3 atk and +3 spd over it).
It is usually not difficult to get Nino into brazen+desperation range, since she has enough bulk to survive most mages/daggers/staves (except for very strong red mages) since it is extremely hard to double her. Once in brazen+desperation range, at neutral, she reaches 61 atk and 55 spd, which is enough to double most abyssal units. If not, even speed wave nearly guarantees it outside of wary effects. 61 atk may not seem like a lot, but again in brazen range she will almost always be getting a free +7 true damage due to Giga Excalibur (which also stacks with AOE specials). This also isn't even considering IVs, which can increase these to 64 atk or 58 spd without any other buffs. Of course, brazen atk/spd 4 is also acceptable but currently is a very premium skill for a small increase in stats, while 3 is on Linus who is a grail unit and easily accessable.
Glimmer is another good choice for special because it is a short cooldown and in most cases is better than moonbow. Moonbow becomes better around when the enemy has an effective 40 res if we consider Nino having 61 atk, which I don't think I see that often in abyssal, or if they do, an AOE special like blazing wind is better anyway. Even atk wave is an alternate to speed wave and is more accessible (on fallen Delthea). Even speed wave may seem like overkill, but there are a few times when I've needed it to double enemies in abyssal, as there are also many debuffs active in abyssal maps. Speed smoke can also be a good option since it is very budget, but it may not reach all enemies if Nino is being danced.
tldr: fury is an overrated skill, use brazens on desperation units, flynino is a really strong unit
